Grooming services

Everything your dog needs to look, feel and smell their best.

Full Groom

The complete package: a warm bath, a full haircut and style, nails trimmed and ears cleaned.

Bath & Tidy

A bath, blow-dry and brush-out with a light tidy-up trim — perfect between full grooms.

Breed-Specific Cuts

Styling true to your dog's breed — from poodle clips to terrier trims and everything in between.

Puppy's First Groom

A calm, patient introduction to grooming that helps young dogs feel at ease on the table.

De-Shedding Treatment

For double-coated dogs: a deep brush-out and bath that lifts loose undercoat and cuts down shedding at home.

Nails & Paw Care

Nail trims and tidy paws — a quick visit that keeps feet comfortable and floors scratch-free.

Every dog is quoted individually. Pricing depends on your dog's breed, size and coat condition — call us and we'll give you a quote for your pup.

Meet Rosanna Mohler

Bonnieland Puppy Parlor is owned and run by Rosanna Mohler, a groomer with 15 years of experience and a European-style approach to grooming — careful scissor work, breed-true styling, and a calm hand with every dog on the table.

Rosanna opened Bonnieland in 2016 here in Canyon Meadows, and the parlor has been a neighbourhood favourite ever since. Since opening day, she has groomed more than 7,000 dogs — from first-time puppies to senior dogs who need a little extra patience.

Whether it's a full breed cut or a simple bath and tidy, every appointment gets the same care: your dog, groomed like her own.
